title: The tame root has nonzero first-order class
statement: Take i:U->L, a finite G-torsor W over U [def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois], Spec R->L and a cartesian chart beta identifying U times_L Spec R with D(f). Let b:R->H, H Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], g=b(f) regular, H/(g) a domain, and n=|G| a unit. Set A=H[t]/(t^n-g), N=Spec A and V=D(g). Suppose N locally Noetherian. Let p be the displayed pullback torsor over V [def-pc-fibre-product], finite etale [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism, def-weil-etale-morphism], a=p followed by V->N, and suppose its relative normalization [lem-weil-pbc-relative-normalization] finite. At any normalization point x whose base prime is (t), assume the base stalk is regular local [def-weil-regular-scheme]. Write C for the normalization stalk, m its maximal ideal, and tau for the image under the structural stalk map of the germ of the explicit root t. Then tau does not belong to m^2. No divisor centre or generic point is in this assertion. Scheme and localization conventions are [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]; residue conventions are [def-weil-residue-field, def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension].

proof.text: Use lem-sbc-normalization-stalk-regular-basic-open with the inverted function g on the source over D(g). The explicit AdjoinRoot relation is t^n=g. Applying the two structural ring maps and positivity of n shows the image tau of t is regular. This part uses no tame ramification.

Apply lem-sbc-root-normalization-dvr-comparison to identify the concrete stalk with the normalization stalk of a group-order root extension over the actual DVR H_(g). Its ring equivalence e preserves the explicit structural root image. This step uses no conclusion about the normalized maximal ideal.

Apply lem-sbc-dvr-root-normalization-maximal-ideal to the model. Map its ideal equality through e using IsLocalRing.map_ringEquiv_maximalIdeal, Ideal.map_span, and the root compatibility. Thus the original maximal ideal m equals span(tau).

If tau lies in m*m=span(tau)*m, Ideal.mem_span_singleton_mul gives z in m with tau*z=tau. Regularity of tau cancels to z=1. This contradicts properness of the actual maximal ideal. The private Lean helpers prove this cancellation argument and the ideal transport; there is no arbitrary-ideal properness gap.

proof_origin.place: DVR comparison and index-one calculation split from Tags 0307, 09EV, 09EB, 0BRM and 09E7; regularity, structural-root relation, ideal transport, and cancellation proved in Lean.

lean.statement:
theorem root_normalization_root_not_square
    {L U : Scheme.{u}} (i : U ⟶ L)
    (G : Type (u + 1)) [Group G] [Finite G] (W : GaloisCover G U)
    (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (φ : Spec R ⟶ L) (f : R)
    (β : pullback i φ ≅ Scheme.Opens.toScheme (X := Spec R)
      (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f))
    (hβ : β.hom ≫ Scheme.Opens.ι (X := Spec R)
      (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f) = pullback.snd i φ)
    (H : CommRingCat.{u}) [IsNoetherianRing H] (b : R ⟶ H)
    (hG : IsUnit (Nat.card G : H)) (hg : IsSMulRegular H (b.hom f))
    [IsDomain (H ⧸ Ideal.span {b.hom f})] :
    let g := b.hom f
    let A := AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial H) ^ Nat.card G - Polynomial.C g)
    let N := Spec (CommRingCat.of A)
    let q := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap H A))
    let V : N.Opens := PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (algebraMap H A g)
    ∀ (hN : IsLocallyNoetherian N),
    let := hN
    let p := pullback.snd (W.π ≫ i) (V.ι ≫ q ≫ Spec.map b ≫ φ)
    ∀ (hp : IsFinite p),
    let := hp
    let a := p ≫ V.ι
    Etale p → IsFinite a.fromNormalization →
    ∀ (x : a.normalization),
      (a.fromNormalization x).asIdeal = Ideal.span
        {AdjoinRoot.root ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial H) ^ Nat.card G - Polynomial.C g)} →
      IsRegularLocalRing (N.presheaf.stalk (a.fromNormalization x)) →
      let C := a.normalization.presheaf.stalk x
      let m := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal C
      let t := AlgebraicGeometry.StructureSheaf.toStalk A (a.fromNormalization x)
        (AdjoinRoot.root ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial H) ^ Nat.card G - Polynomial.C g))
      (a.fromNormalization.stalkMap x).hom t ∉ m * m
